dataset_name: Published Batam Gajah Mada 16-18 February 2023 road-speed survey
title: Pengaruh U-Turn terhadap Kinerja Lalu Lintas pada Ruas Jalan Gajah Mada Depan Simpang Sekolah Kemilau Bangsa Kota Batam
license: CC BY-SA 4.0 as displayed on article page
attribution: Kurniawan and Anwar (2023), Sigma Teknika6(2),479-492, Table11 p487; direct transcription, decimal commas normalized, explicit interval offsets and quality diagnostics added. No author endorsement.
source_method: 100m segment; authors report sampling3vehicles every15minutes; published table groups30minute intervals. Raw vehicle-level values and per-interval counts unavailable.
location: Jalan Gajah Mada in front of Kemilau Bangsa School intersection, Tiban, Batam
scope_limitations: One surveyed site, two directions and three days, peak windows only.
Reference speed is calculated using PKJI, not measured free flow.
Published means need not equal inverse mean travel times; discrepancies are flagged, not silently corrected.
Not imported into canonical Batam speed history: exact geocoding and corridor/direction mapping remain unverified.
Insufficient coverage to promote a network forecasting model.
